newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling firm vs dlr on good supply.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling firm vs dlr on good supply.

text.p: Good inflows from the coffee sector helped the Kenyan shilling open the year firmer against the dollar on Thursday, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a mean shilling average of 54.97 against the dollar from 55.02 on Tuesday, while against the pound the shilling was posted at 94.03 from 93.05.
Dealers said the shilling appeared to have stabilised after the holiday season as activity picked up with inflows streaming in from coffee traders.
"There was some demand from the oil sector but the inflows were more which helped strengthen the shilling," one dealer said.
Commercial bank dealers said the shilling opened at 54.85/95 levels and by mid-morning was trading at 54.83/93 levels.
The money market was very liquid with shillings streaming in from treasury bill maturities on Monday. Overnight rates were quoted at below 10 percent from 10-15 percent levels on Tuesday.
